decisions.reason: As a multi-model extension of the core office offer with its own page, this desk system represents visible investment and a good strategic fit with flexible workplace interiors, so management is likely to persist.
The chair family is close to the established range and was given dedicated presentation, which makes it easier for management to justify continued support despite any early uncertainty.
These floor cushions are somewhat more niche, but they still build on the firm's design-led interiors concept and the firm has already committed enough variety and visibility to favor continuation.

The sofa is close to the firm's established business, but weaker website prominence suggests lower public commitment, making it the most vulnerable product even though management would still tend to give it more time.
The high standing table fits contemporary workplace and lounge trends and received its own page, so sunk development and marketing effort make a near-term withdrawal unlikely.

Although rugs are more distant from the traditional offer, management publicly framed this collection as a flagship direction, which strongly encourages escalation of commitment and continued backing.
